item.title: Kids Making It awarded $900,000 from The Endowment to expand youth programs
item.description: Kids Making It, a Wilmington-based nonprofit that teaches woodworking, vocational, entrepreneurial and life skills to disadvantaged youth, has been awarded a $900,000 grant from the New Hanover Community Endowment.

item.title: Nearly 5,500 athletes expected for 16th annual Novant Health Wilmington Marathon
item.description: Nearly 5,500 athletes are expected to take part in the 16th annual Novant Health Wilmington Marathon on Saturday.

item.title: New Hanover County deputy terminated following internal investigation
item.description: A New Hanover County Sheriff’s deputy has been terminated following an internal affairs investigation, according to a disciplinary action charge sheet.

item.title: Town of Leland proposed $50 million budget for 2026-27 submitted to town council
item.description: The proposed $50 million budget includes a reduction in the tax rate and focuses on several areas, including public safety and ongoing projects.

item.title: Donna Gregory’s Extraordinary People: A Mission of Warmth and Dignity in Wilmington
item.description: On the coldest nights in Wilmington, the Warming Shelter ILM on Grace Street opens to provide warmth, safety, and a place to rest for people seeking protection from freezing temperatures.

item.title: Chadbourn to start advertisement for new town manager after heated emergency meeting
item.description: The town of Chadbourn is looking for a new manager and attorney after a heated emergency meeting this weekend.

item.title: Wilmington Parks and Recreation board discusses next steps at Greenville Loop Road park
item.description: The city of Wilmington’s Park and Recreation advisory board is discussing next steps for a new 25-acre park on Greenville Loop Road.

item.title: Ribbon cutting ceremony held for Shallotte’s only area Biscuitville location
item.description: If you drove through Shallotte this morning and saw a long line, it wasn't for gas... It was for biscuits!

item.title: NCHSAA releases state playoff basketball brackets
item.description: The North Carolina High School Athletic Association has released the state playoff brackets, previewing the upcoming postseason for all eight classifications of boys’ and girls’ high school basketball.

item.title: Early voting surging in North Carolina as primary election draws near
item.description: According to a study done by Dr. Michael Bitzer, a political scientist at Catawba College, more than 320,000 early voting ballots have already been accepted, a more than 15 percent increase compared to the last primary election in 20-24.
